normalized.prelim_summary: This 2011 Cayman S has low miles but has been heavily modified with a TPC Racing turbo kit and other performance parts, along with a documented repaint from a 2021 incident. Well documented with Carfax, invoices, and a dyno sheet, but old tires and emissions concerns are worth noting. The auction ended with a high bid of $36,250, reserve not met.
